page.overview:
Who is Tollbooth?

Tollbooth was an engineering prodigy. The building sets he made as a child were renowned for their size and complexity. It was only natural that he entered MIT for his engineering degree. When he became involved in construction projects, he made his reputation for finding solutions to engineering problems that haven't cropped up until they went past the drawing board. Finding solutions became his personal challenge and when he ran out of anything to pick out, the military became his next stepping stone. There it became his job to find all manner of ideas to get past the obstacles to where the Joe Team have to be. He couldn't be happier.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

! colspan="2" style="border:1px solid black" |Generation 1

Tollbooth was one of the number of action figures packaged exclusively with a vehicle for the run of A Real American Hero in 1985. He was bundled together with the Bridge Layer vehicle. ---- Appearance: orange hard hat; brown hair; open-collared, short-sleeved, olive green shirt with silver dogtag, brown vest, and black gloves; orange-brown pants with brown belt and boots and black holster.
